environment: TypeScript transpile + isolated Node VM; actual DOM parser, mocked Supabase Auth/RPC and mocked upstream HTTP. No paid API or live Supabase calls.

checks.name: scraper rejects absent or invalid identity before fetching
scraper rejects logged-in non-editor before fetching
scraper blocks spoofed hosts, private hosts and HTTP
scraper rejects unsafe redirect without following it
scraper extracts title/date/content from actual DOM parser
scraper does not report empty extraction as success
scraper enforces response size cap
AI endpoint rejects non-editor and missing title/content
AI fallback returns validated JSON; key absent from URL
AI rejects malformed analysis instead of returning status 200
AI permission error is not mislabeled as model busy
reported 503-404-503 pattern returns service failure with one bounded retry
default fallback switches from overloaded 3.8 to supported Flash-Lite
transient server failure can recover on a single delayed retry
all 404 results identify model configuration and are never retried
quota errors preserve 429 and are not automatically retried
bad upstream request remains an HTTP configuration error, not invalid analysis
other upstream HTTP errors are not mislabeled as malformed analysis
timeouts return 504 without starting an extra retry
invalid model setting stops before external requests
model prefixes are normalized, deduplicated and capped at three candidates
content block is reported directly without probing fallback or retries
truncated generations report output length instead of generic busy status
reasoning parts are excluded from analysis JSON
upstream messages and secrets never enter error text or logs
Dashboard single-file variants contain working owner gates
Dashboard AI single-file version performs the same overload fallback
